name: Forza Horizon 6: VIP Membership
summary: Forza Horizon 6 VIP Membership is your permanent ticket to even more rewards at the Horizon Festival. Enjoy a 2x Credit boost to race rewards, 3 VIP-Exclusive Forza Edition cars, a weekly bonus Super Wheelspin, and special Vanity Items including the Crown Flair, Emote and Car Horn. You’ll also be handed the keys to the lavish Tokyo City House, a classic Japanese home in the suburbs that includes a Customizable Garage with a space to show off your favorite cars. Forza Horizon 6 VIP Membership can be purchased separately and is included with Premium Edition and Premium Upgrade. This lifetime membership is a single purchase and will always be yours to enjoy in Forza Horizon 6. Join the Horizon VIP Club today!
